About the job
Korvel Automotive is a family-owned Tier 1 supplier of seat structures, stamped and welded metal assemblies and e-coated parts for European car makers. Our Polish plant on the southern outskirts of Warsaw employs around 740 people in three shifts and supplies eleven vehicle programmes, two of them for a new electric platform that starts production in Q2 2027.

The plant is under pressure. Overall equipment effectiveness has dropped to 58 %, scrap stands at 4.1 %, and two customers have placed us in controlled shipping level 2 after repeated delivery and quality issues. The plant manager left the company in August. We are looking for an experienced interim plant manager who takes over immediately, turns the plant around and prepares it for the launch of the new programmes.

Your responsibilities
- Full P&L responsibility for the plant, leading a management team of nine (production, maintenance, quality, logistics, engineering, HR, finance)
- Stabilise delivery performance and exit controlled shipping with both customers by the end of Q1 2027
- Raise OEE on the press and welding lines through a structured shopfloor management, SMED and TPM programme
- Reduce scrap and customer complaints together with quality, lead 8D problem solving for the top issues
- Prepare the plant for the IATF 16949 surveillance audit in March 2027
- Drive the launch readiness for the new EV programmes (capacity planning, APQP, run at rate)
- Work constructively with the trade unions and the employee representatives on shift models and overtime
- Develop a permanent successor from the local team or support the external search

Your profile
- 10+ years in automotive manufacturing, at least 5 of them as plant manager, production director or operations director
- Proven turnaround results in a Tier 1 or Tier 2 environment, ideally in metal forming, welding or surface treatment
- Deep knowledge of lean production, Six Sigma and IATF 16949
- Experience with controlled shipping, customer escalations and OEM launch processes
- Fluent English; Polish is a strong plus, German is helpful for the communication with our headquarters
- Willingness to work on site in Warsaw five days per week for the full assignment

What we offer
- Interim assignment for 6 months starting 2 November 2026, extension likely
- Day rate of EUR 1,050 to 1,200 depending on experience, plus travel and accommodation
- Serviced apartment close to the plant for the whole assignment
- Contract as a service agreement with Korvel Group GmbH in Germany
- A committed team that wants the plant to succeed
